questions.q: Why does a generator need NO inverter?
choices: it stores power in a battery
why: No — a generator burns fuel on demand; it does not store in a battery.
Correct! The alternator already produces AC, so no DC-to-AC inverter is needed.

questions.q: About how much diesel does a generator burn per kilowatt-hour?
why: Correct! Roughly 0.3 L of diesel per kWh for a typical genset.
No — that is about ten times too much fuel.
No — that is far too much; a genset is more efficient than that.
